decision_needed: Approve the area codes FMW (Chapter 2) and TEC (technology and AI).
what_the_files_show: The codes were left open at G0 (decision log and run record). All 48 draft issues use them, and the labels are country-neutral.

decision_needed: Keep or retire RI-TEC-008 (electronic public consultation platform).
what_the_files_show: It has 12 EU requirement items and no recommendation. Procedure P2 requires a theme issue to rest on at least one in-scope recommendation that meets the materiality test, so it fails as drafted. Its drafter also noted that technology is the channel, not the problem.
agent_recommendation: Retire it (status retired; the ID stays). Its 12 items then fit no issue.

decision_needed: Resolve the overlap between RI-TEC-031 and the Chapter 2 issues.
what_the_files_show: All 13 items under RI-TEC-031 are also mapped to Chapter 2 issues (RI-FMW-004; -005; -008 to -011), so it adds no evidence of its own. RI-FMW-005 and RI-FMW-010 already carry the technology theme tags.
agent_recommendation: Merge RI-TEC-031 into RI-FMW-010 (merged_into); EURES IT items stay under RI-FMW-005.

decision_needed: Narrow RI-TEC-005 (tax IT and e-services) to fit decision R22.
what_the_files_show: At G3, tax IT upgrades were set as out by default unless the claim concerns an EU connection or a service the public uses online. Most of the 16 items pair the back-office integrated IT tax system with e-services in one sentence or list. The stand-alone Integrated Tax Information System sentences were left out of the 2024 and 2025 reports, so the issue currently reads wider than the extraction.
agent_recommendation: Narrow the label and definition to taxpayer e-services, and treat the integrated IT tax system as out of the issue except where a quote also covers e-services. Keep the 14 recommendations mapped.

decision_needed: Decide whether RI-TEC-003 (digital public services) is too broad.
what_the_files_show: It is the largest issue: 119 items from 24 sources, of which 52 are recommendations. A keyword count suggests mostly general e-services (about 54) and business or licensing services (about 39). It may fail the granularity test.
agent_recommendation: Approve as one issue for version 1.0 and test it at G5 classification. Split only if items cannot be assigned consistently: splitting now would mean remapping without evidence that it is needed.

decision_needed: Keep RI-TEC-001 (artificial intelligence) as a separate issue on a thin EU base.
what_the_files_show: Two EU recommendation items (MKD-EU-2025-001-0149; MKD-EU-2026-005-0002). A keyword check of all EU text found no missed North Macedonia requirement on AI; the AI law conditions in MKD-EU-2024-007 are Serbia's (page 60). One of the two items only encourages outreach around an AI Factory Antenna, so the base is effectively one firm recommendation.
agent_recommendation: Keep it: AI is named in the run scope, and thin EU coverage is itself a finding (ALN-0018). National evidence comes at stage 8.

decision_needed: Keep or merge the small Chapter 2 issues RI-FMW-011 (EHIC) and RI-FMW-012 (supplementary pensions).
what_the_files_show: RI-FMW-011 has 7 items and is flagged as a merge candidate with RI-FMW-008. RI-FMW-012 has 7 items and one recommendation from one source.
agent_recommendation: Keep both. EHIC is named in the run scope and supplementary pensions are a distinct acquis topic; neither needs to reach the priority list to stay in the taxonomy.

decision_needed: Confirm the sector issues on the R12 and R22 boundary.
what_the_files_show: RI-TEC-006 (procurement), -007 (services and professions), -009 (eHealth), -010 (justice), -029 (customs), -030 (justice and home affairs systems) and -032 (other EU systems) sit on the boundary. RI-TEC-010 has 7 recommendations but only 2 not flagged theme_doubtful.
agent_recommendation: Keep six as online public services or EU connections, which R12 and R22 let in. Keep RI-TEC-010 provisionally and recheck it at G5, because court IT may be back-office under R22.

decision_needed: Decide how to handle the flagged doubtful and unmapped items.
what_the_files_show: 292 items carry theme_doubtful (288 EU; 4 from non-EU sample sources); 63 are mapped to an issue. 137 EU requirement items fit no issue: mainly chapter-level ratings or doubtful items, plus 5 others that name no specific problem or are chain items. Row-by-row review would be heavy.
agent_recommendation: Decide by group, not row: accept the unmapped list as it stands, and leave doubtful items flagged until classification, when the materiality test is applied per item. No new issue for domain name registry governance (7 items).
affects: Theme doubtful items and Items fitting no issue sheets

what_the_files_show: Proposals are on the Mechanism proposals sheet: rewordings of MEC-01; -03; -07; -08; -09 and two additions, implementation gap (NEW-01) and low uptake of existing systems (MEC-11). MEC-01 and MEC-03 each have two proposals, one from each drafter. MEC-02 has a blank version field.
agent_recommendation: Combine the paired rewordings of MEC-01 and MEC-03; accept the other rewordings; add both new mechanisms, as MEC-11 (low uptake) and MEC-12 (implementation gap). Record the list as version 1.0, which also fills the MEC-02 gap.

decision_needed: Decide how to record issues that span clusters.
what_the_files_show: 11 technology issues have a blank cluster because their chapters span clusters, and RI-TEC-004 also has no chapter because its items name none. The data dictionary describes cluster as a cluster number and does not cover this case.
agent_recommendation: Allow a blank cluster to mean cross-cluster and a blank chapter to mean no chapter stated; record this in the data dictionary with a version change.
